design_philosophy: Raw, confident, community-driven. Editorial-magazine layout, asymmetric grids, oversized type, marquee/ticker bands, rough hand-drawn elements echoing the leaf logo, grain/noise overlay.

colors.usage_rules: Primary palette is purely #FFFFFF and #000000. Accents (#2F4A5A, #2F4F3E, #C25A46) must only be used as tiny dots, single-word highlights, or small hover state accents (<= 5% of surface).

scales.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[10vw] font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none
scales.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-7xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight leading-none
scales.body: text-base md:text-lg font-normal uppercase tracking-widest leading-relaxed
scales.marquee: text-6xl md:text-8xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter whitespace-nowrap

typography.rules: Montserrat everywhere. Headings are Bold/Black All-Caps. Body is Regular All-Caps. Extreme scale contrast between headings and body text.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento 'Tetris' Grid for features and gallery. Asymmetry and negative space.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid black for light sections, 1px solid white/20 for dark sections. Sharp corners (rounded-none).

components_strategy.html_tailwind_focus: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for marketing layouts (hero, manifesto, gallery).
components_strategy.shadcn_usage: Use Shadcn customized components ONLY for the lead capture form (Input, Textarea, Button, Checkbox).
components_strategy.animations: Framer Motion for scroll reveals. react-fast-marquee for discipline bands. High-contrast hover states (e.g. bg-white hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300).
components_strategy.visual_effects: Grain overlay (pointer-events-none fixed full-screen noise). Halftone or grayscale CSS filters on images (grayscale contrast-125).

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Sticky top bar, solid background or backdrop-blur, brand logo, minimal nav, 'Inscreva-se' CTA.

sections.name: Hero
sections.description: Massive typography, bold logo presence. Brand statement. Dual CTA: 'Inscreva-se' (Solid Black) and 'WhatsApp' (Outline). Background should be a high-contrast gritty image with a black/white overlay.
sections.style: h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-end p-4 md:p-12 relative overflow-hidden

sections.name: Marquee Divider
sections.description: Continuously scrolling text of disciplines: SURFSKATE • SURF • JIU-JITSU • PURE CREW

sections.name: A CREW (About)
sections.description: Manifesto-style. Raw lifestyle ethos. Huge leading text, asymmetric layout. Introduce the vibe.
sections.style: bg-white text-black py-24 md:py-32 px-4 md:px-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8

sections.name: Modalidades (Disciplines)
sections.description: 3 signature cards/blocks for SURFSKATE, SURF, JIU-JITSU. Huge numbering (01, 02, 03).
sections.style: bg-black text-white py-24 md:py-32 px-4 md:px-12

sections.name: Galeria (Visuals)
sections.description: Masonry or Bento grid of raw photos (surf, skate, jiu-jitsu, community). Grayscale filter on all.

sections.name: Merch Teaser
sections.description: Small section, not the focus. Link to shop.

sections.name: Inscrição / Contato
sections.description: Lead capture form (Name, Email, Phone, Modality, Message) + direct WhatsApp and Instagram CTAs.
sections.style: bg-[#0a0a0a] text-white py-24 px-4 md:px-12 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-16

sections.name: Footer
sections.description: Massive brand mark, copyright, social links (Instagram, WhatsApp, YouTube, Email).
sections.style: bg-black text-white py-12 px-4 border-t border-white/20 text-center md:text-left

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Montserrat font from Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS.
No testimonials section as per user request.
Ensure all imagery is visually forced into black and white using CSS (grayscale) unless it's already B&W.
Add a fixed, pointer-events-none noise/grain overlay div covering the entire viewport to give it a gritty editorial feel.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).
Use lucide-react for any icons needed.
Implement the contact form using Shadcn but strip the Vercel-look and use brutalist styling (square corners, bold borders).
Create a solid, working lead capture form layout and include placeholder WhatsApp/Instagram links.
Do not add generic corporate 'card' shadows. Use hard borders and solid colors.
Use framer-motion for simple on-scroll reveals (fade in up) to give the page momentum.
